title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's AP-220 exam
question:
A customer proposes a new integration to align with their Order Management vision.
What is the most important factor to evaluate first?
option_A: The integration's feasibility within the existing system architecture.
option_B: The compatibility of the integration with Salesforce API limits.
option_C: The availability of pre-built solutions for the integration.
option_D: The estimated cost of the integration project.
